tasks.old_behavior: Integer does not have a bit_count method; calling it raises NoMethodError.
tasks.new_behavior: Integer#bit_count returns the population count (number of set bits) of the integer's binary representation. Raises ArgumentError for negative integers.
tasks.compatibility_reason: Purely additive API change. A new public method Integer#bit_count is introduced. No existing API, contract, or behavior is modified. Existing code that does not call bit_count is unaffected. In rare cases where a subclass or monkey-patch defined bit_count on Integer, the built-in method would override it, but this is an edge case and the change follows the standard pattern for Ruby feature additions.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run existing test_bit_count and test_bit_count_for_negative_numbers tests in test/ruby/test_integer.rb to verify fixnum and bignum behavior, including boundary conditions (0, positive integers, negative integer rejection). Also verify via direct smoke programs that Integer#bit_count returns correct values for common cases.
